sections.title: Six details that lead to a useful freight response
intro: A precise request lets the team assess PTL, FTL, container or specialised movement without unnecessary back-and-forth.
list: Exact locations Origin, destination, industrial area and PIN codes.
Cargo Material description and any classification or handling requirement.
Packages Type, count, dimensions, weight and stackability.
Equipment Forklift, crane, dock or labour available at both ends.
Timing Ready date, receiving hours and delivery appointment.
Terms Paid, to-pay or billing; door, godown, DACC or COD options.

faqs.q: Does Vidhi Transport have a branch serving Bhiwandi?
faqs.a: Yes. Bhiwandi Branch is listed at Gala No. 1, New Madhvi Compound, Near Narayan Talpatriwala, Anjur Road, Anjur Phata, Bhiwandi, Maharashtra 421302. Call +91 63598 93366 to confirm the exact pickup, delivery, cargo and timing requirement.

faqs.q: Which nearby areas are coordinated from Bhiwandi Branch?
faqs.a: The listed service areas include Bhiwandi, Anjur, Wadpe, Wada, Vasai, Palghar. These are coverage references, not claims of a separate physical office in every locality.

faqs.q: Which transport services can I request in Bhiwandi?
faqs.a: The branch can assess requirements for Part Load Transport, Full Truckload Transport, Urgent freight coordination, E-commerce support, Warehousing support. Availability and acceptance depend on the cargo, route, documentation, schedule and operational approval.

faqs.q: What should I share for a freight quote from Bhiwandi?
faqs.a: Share exact origin and destination with PIN codes, material description, packaging, package count, actual weight and dimensions, dispatch date, loading method, delivery option and any special handling or regulatory information.
